state:
**Goal `ext-intl`: Stage 5 (dates, relative time, lists) is in progress.** `format-date-times`, `format-dates` and `format-times` are implemented in `extensions/intl/src/dates.rs` over `icu_datetime`'s `FieldSetBuilder`, from the local fields, offset and IANA id the host sends; the module doc owns the zone styles and their fallbacks. `extensions/intl/nvs/DateFormat.nvs` reads a `Core\Time\DateTime`'s fields with `format` (`u`, `M`, `d`, `H`, `m`, `s`, `SSSSSSSSS`, `VV`) and its offset with `zone()->offsetAt(...)->toSeconds()`, because `Core\Time` values have no field properties. `a_core_time_value_formats_in_its_zone_and_locale` and `the_guest_carries_no_time_zone_database` (`crates/nvs-ext/tests/intl.rs`) pass, so check `nvs-ext-dates-relative-time-and-lists` now owes only its two other tests.

The guest wasm grew from 3,281,713 to 7,142,436 bytes with the date data, mostly zone names (not measured apart). Stage 7 records the size.

`format-relative`, `format-lists`, `word-segments`, `sentence-segments`, `resolve-locales` and `negotiate` still return `runtime`.

next.title: dates and times, relative time, lists

items.text: **Implement `format-relative` and `format-lists`** at `extensions/intl/src/lib.rs:247` and `extensions/intl/src/lib.rs:255`: relative time over `icu_experimental`'s relative-time formatter, lists over `icu_list`. Write `extensions/intl/nvs/RelativeTime.nvs` and `extensions/intl/nvs/ListFormat.nvs` beside `extensions/intl/nvs/DateFormat.nvs:1`. Tests `relative_time_formats_past_and_future` and `a_list_formats_with_its_locale_conjunction` go after `crates/nvs-ext/tests/intl.rs:735`, reusing its `written` and `shape` helpers. Owned by ADR 0277 § 1 and § 9.

**Write the two Stage 5 cases** `tests/conformance/novis/intl-dates-format-in-their-zone-and-locale.nvst` and `tests/conformance/novis/intl-relative-time-and-lists.nvst`, in the shape of `tests/conformance/novis/intl-numbers-format-by-locale.nvst:1`. The dates case can pin what a debug `nvs run` printed: `DateFormat::dateTimes` of Vienna 2026-07-14 15:05:09 in `en` is `Jul 14, 2026, 3:05 PM` (a U+202F before `PM`), in `de` with `{zone: ZoneStyle::Generic, seconds: true}` is `14.07.2026, 15:05:09 Mitteleuropäische Zeit`, and a `Zone::fixed` offset of two hours names itself `GMT+02:00`.

backlog: `rule:packaging/the-first-party-components-are-built-in`'s *Partly on disk* paragraph still names only `collateOrder` and `sortKeys` as implemented; rewrite it when Stage 5 closes (its fragment under `docs/rules/packaging/`).
Stage 7: the size each component's module doc states (`nvs-ext` check `the_recorded_growth_matches_the_embedded_components`); the zone-name share of the date data is not measured.
Stage 8: feature proofs for every `Novis\Intl` class (`bun nv proofs --id`).
